data.one_liner: Themeable widget library with 45+ token-driven components and context-free message APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 45 themeable Flutter components inspired by Ant Design, built entirely on widgets without Material dependencies. It includes context-free notification and message APIs that do not require a BuildContext.
use_when: Building an app that requires a comprehensive design token system without a heavy Material dependency
Needing context-free feedback APIs like toast messages and notifications
Creating multi-platform apps that need customizable, consistent UI components
avoid_when: You want a UI library strictly adhering to Google's Material Design or Apple's Cupertino guidelines
You are not using a navigator key and rely solely on context-based overlays for notifications
strengths: No Material dependency, works seamlessly in both Material and Cupertino applications
Token-driven theming makes global style changes simple
Context-free feedback APIs allow triggering messages from anywhere in code
weaknesses: Public API is not fully stable while on 0.x version
Requires manual configuration of navigator key for root-level notifications
data.setup_notes: Optionally configure UiKit.navigatorKey in your MaterialApp to enable context-free message and notification APIs.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Material Design widgets instead of Ant Design-inspired components.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer native Apple-style Cupertino widgets.
